channel.title: Project Planar Player's Guide
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Project Planar Player's Guide

item.title: 425 Archon
item.description: 425 · Archon Archon is the Archdevil of Tyranny, and the other half of Themis, the Archangel of Justice.

item.title: 424 Lux
item.description: 424 · Lux Lux is the Archdevil of Pride, and the other half of Pavlas, the Archangel of Humility.

item.title: 421 Belphegor
item.description: 421 · Belphegor Belphegor is the Archdevil of Indulgence.

item.title: 426 Lilien
item.description: 426 · Lilien Lilien is the Archdevil of Desire, and the other half of Gwenhael, the Archangel of Sacrifice. Lilien is split down the middle.

item.title: 423 Tiyanak
item.description: 423 · Tiyanak Tiyanak is the Archdevil of Deceit, and the other half of Verita, the Archangel of Truth.

item.title: Warlock Scholarch
item.description: Your patron is one of the three Scholarchs of Temporalis, who are also the three sphinxes: It That Was, It That Is, and It That Will Be.

item.title: 460 The Wind Gods
item.description: 460 · The Wind Gods Four of them, one for each quarter of Ventis.

item.title: 100 What You Are
item.description: 100 · What You Are Nine Progenitors were born out of the Planar Collision. Each one wanted company and each one made a people.

item.title: 130 Elves
item.description: 130 · Elves Sylvana Lorien made the elves, and she is still very proud of them. She will not hear a word said against them.

item.title: Rogue Soulknife
item.description: Add a ”## Level N” heading for each level this subclass actually gets a feature at — skip any that don’t apply.
